newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P rates Pacific Retail CP ay A-1 plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Pacific Retail CP ay A-1 plus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Monday it had assigned its A-1 plus credit rating to Pacific Retail Securities Ltd's NZ$250 million commercial paper programme.

S&P said the rating of the programme was based on the strength of the transaction structure, the credit quality of the underlying assets, the credit reserves and the standby liquidity facilities from counterparties rated A-1 plus.

The proceeds of the commercial paper issuance will be used to buy hire-purchase contract receivables originated by the Pacific Retail Group Ltd group of companies. This group consists of Noel Leeming, Bond and Bond Ltd, and the Computer Store.
Pacific Retail Group, formerly known as Noel Leeming, is the largest retailer of home appliances and consumer electronics in New Zealand. --Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
